description: Windows window manager inspired by macOS Stage Manager, with per-monitor app groups.
pre_install: $binary = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Filter 'StageManagerForWindows.*.amd64.exe' -File | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $binary) { throw 'Stage Manager executable was not found.' }; Rename-Item -LiteralPath $binary.FullName -NewName 'StageManagerForWindows.exe'
